name: infosys
description: Monorepo do InfoSys — Gestão operacional para prestadores de serviço técnico.
author: Gustavo Amancio <gustavoamanciocom@gmail.com>

scripts.dev:api: bun run build:shared && bun run --cwd apps/api dev
scripts.dev:web: bun run build:shared && bun run --cwd apps/web dev
scripts.build: bun run build:shared && bun run --parallel build:api build:web
scripts.lint: bun run build:shared && bun run --cwd packages/shared lint && bun run --cwd apps/api lint && bun run --cwd apps/web lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun run build:shared && bun run --cwd apps/api lint:fix && bun run --cwd apps/web lint:fix
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:shared && bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build:shared && bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.test:api: bun run build:shared && bun run --cwd apps/api test
scripts.test:web: bun run build:shared && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.test:cov: bun run build:shared && bun run --cwd apps/api test:cov
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build:shared && bun run --cwd apps/api test:e2e
